hints.title: Too many multiplications
hints.body: A loop that multiplies once per exponent step is too slow for large exponents.

hints.title: Square the base
hints.body: Cut the exponent in half and square the base so each step handles two powers at once.

hints.title: Negative powers
hints.body: Invert the base and negate the exponent before applying the fast method.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
power = exponent
if power < 0:
    base = 1 / base
    power = -power
result = 1
while power > 0:
    if power is odd:
        result = result * base
    base = base * base
    power = power // 2
return result
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
